new_jobs.title: Senior Operations Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Company Overview** Our client is a leading global technology and manufacturing organization with a longstanding reputation for engineering excellence, innovation, and delivering highly engineered solutions to some of the world's most demanding industries. With a strong international presence and a history spanning more than a century, the company partners with leading customers to develop advanced technologies that support critical industrial and semiconductor applications. The organization continues to invest in its global manufacturing capabilities, operational excellence, and talent development to support long-term growth. Its Taiwan operations play an important role in serving the semiconductor industry, providing sophisticated products and manufacturing solutions in a technically demanding, high-mix, low-volume environment. **Position Overview** Our client is seeking an accomplished, hands-on **Senior Manager, Operations** to lead its manufacturing facility in Miaoli County, Taiwan. This individual will have comprehensive responsibility for site performance, overseeing Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, and Facilities. The successful candidate will be a commercially minded operations leader capable of balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution. The role requires someone who thrives in complex, high-mix, low-volume (HMLV) manufacturing environments, understands the demanding requirements of semiconductor customers, and has a demonstrated ability to improve operational performance while developing high-performing teams. This is a highly visible leadership opportunity within a global manufacturing organization, requiring close collaboration with regional and global leadership to strengthen operational capabilities, support business growth, and drive continuous improvement. **Key Responsibilities** **Site Leadership & Financial Performance** * Provide overall leadership for the Taiwan manufacturing operation, including Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and Facilities. * Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with business objectives, customer requirements, and growth initiatives. * Partner with Finance to manage operating budgets, capital expenditures, standard costs, inventory, and working capital. * Drive accountability for site performance, including safety, quality, delivery, productivity, cost, and organizational development. * Lead the implementation and integration of global operating systems, ERP platforms, reporting standards, and best practices. **Manufacturing Operations & Operational Excellence** * Establish a disciplined operating environment built around daily management, KPI visibility, structured problem-solving, and continuous improvement. * Lead production planning, capacity management, workforce allocation, and resource optimization to support changing customer demands. * Improve manufacturing efficiency, throughput, on-time delivery, lead times, and cost performance. * Champion Lean manufacturing principles and build a culture of accountability, operational discipline, and continuous improvement. * Lead new product introductions (NPI), manufacturing transfers, production ramp-ups, and customer qualification activities. **Engineering, Quality & Supply Chain** * Oversee manufacturing/process engineering, quality engineering, and applicable design engineering activities supporting site operations. * Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 quality management standards, customer requirements, and semiconductor industry change-control protocols. * Lead customer quality escalations, audits, root-cause investigations, and corrective action initiatives. * Strengthen supply chain performance through effective supplier management, material planning, inventory optimization, and risk mitigation. * Partner with commercial and engineering teams to support customer requirements and successful product launches. **Talent Development & Organizational Leadership** * Build, develop, and mentor a high-performing leadership team across manufacturing, engineering, quality, and supply chain. * Establish clear performance expectations, accountability, and succession plans throughout the organization. * Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, employee engagement, retention, and organizational development. * Foster a collaborative, results-oriented culture that encourages ownership, continuous improvement, and employee development. * Represent the Taiwan operation in regional and global leadership discussions, ensuring alignment across the broader organization. **EHS, Compliance & Business Continuity** * Maintain accountability for environmental, health, and safety performance across the facility. * Ensure compliance with applicable Taiwan labor, occupational safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements. * Oversee business continuity planning and risk mitigation related to supply chain disruptions, natural disasters, and operational interruptions. * Support compliance with applicable ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards, export regulations, and corporate policies. **Candidate Qualifications** **Required Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Supply Chain, or a related technical discipline. * Minimum of 12 years of progressive manufacturing or operations experience, including significant leadership responsibility. * At least 5 years of experience leading multiple operational functions or a complex manufacturing organization. * Experience within semiconductor, semiconductor equipment, advanced electronics, precision manufacturing, or similarly demanding technology-driven industries. * Demonstrated success managing high-mix, low-volume manufacturing operations. * Broad functional leadership experience across manufacturing, engineering, quality, and supply chain. * Strong understanding of production planning, capacity management, inventory control, quality systems, and manufacturing engineering. * Proven track record of improving operational KPIs, including on-time delivery, lead times, productivity, quality, inventory, and manufacturing costs. * Experience working directly with demanding customers, managing audits, and resolving complex operational challenges. * Working knowledge of Taiwan labor laws, occupational safety requirements, and manufacturing compliance. * Fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese, including Traditional Chinese business communication. **Preferred Qualifications** * Advanced degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, or Business Administration. * Experience supporting global semiconductor OEMs, semiconductor equipment manufacturers, or fabrication facilities. * Background in semiconductor capital equipment, thermal management systems, precision manufacturing, or electromechanical assemblies. * Experience leading NPI, manufacturing transfers, product industrialization, and customer qualification processes. * Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, or related operational excellence expertise. * Previous responsibility for a manufacturing facility in Taiwan. * Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 management systems. * Experience operating within a global, matrixed manufacturing organization. **Ideal Leadership Profile** Our client is seeking more than a traditional manufacturing manager. The ideal candidate is a **hands-on, business-oriented operations leader** who can drive measurable improvements while building the organizational capabilities necessary for sustainable growth. This individual will demonstrate: * **Hands-on Leadership:** Comfortable spending significant time on the manufacturing floor, engaging directly with employees, identifying challenges, and driving solutions. * **Commercial & Financial Acumen:** Understands how manufacturing decisions influence profitability, working capital, customer satisfaction, and business growth. * **Operational Discipline:**

Grows the business and outperforms our markets. * Consistently achieves results, even under adverse circumstances; continuously improve customer satisfaction. * Builds a pipeline of high performing, diverse teams and optimize the order fufillment process. * Be passionate for the customer service activities, conveying optimism about the future and its possibilities * Sets expectations high and galvanizes the team to achieve them; Our goal is to give you the space to find that sweet spot where your passion meets purpose.**

new_jobs.title: APAC Lead, AI and Infrastructure Strategic Initiatives (Mandarin, English)
new_jobs.jd: Google welcomes people with disabilities. **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Semiconductor Physics, Business, or equivalent practical experience. * 15 years of experience in business development, semiconductor and EMS supply chain management, or technology partnerships. * Experience working with C-level executives and managing multi-stakeholder initiatives in the technology or supply chain domain. * Ability to communicate in Mandarin and English fluently to support client relationship management in this region. **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience in technical and commercial AI infrastructure and supply chain ecosystems. * Ability to architect and deploy large-scale hardware/AI infrastructure initiatives (e.g., custom ASIC/TPU deployment, data center compute scaling, sovereign cloud infrastructure). * Ability to influence internal and external senior executives stakeholders across complex, highly matrixed organizations. * Excellent business judgment, analytical excellence skills, and capacity to structure novel partnerships under ambiguous or rapidly shifting market conditions. **About The Job** Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines. Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands. The AI and Infrastructure (AI2) Strategy and Operations team drives operational excellence, executive enablement, and strategic alignment across AI and Infrastructure. In this role, you will bridge executive goal and engineering execution, governing cross-functional initiatives, optimizing critical resourcing, and accelerating the planetary-scale delivery of next-generation AI platforms. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. **Responsibilities** * Formulate and execute holistic APAC AI infrastructure and supply chain strategies in direct alignment with the AI2 executive leadership team. * Drive executive-level engagements with senior leaders at major semiconductor foundries, memory and key components vendors, and other supply chain partners across APAC to secure long-term ecosystem commitments. * Form the strategy and lead the regional rollout for TPU APAC expansion, including TPU neoclouds, sovereign AIs, first-party data center expansions, and project bloom execution. * Direct cross-functional alignment across AI2 hardware engineering, systems architecture, global supply chain, and deployment teams to synchronize demand signals with strategic commitments. * Evaluate global macro industry trends, geopolitical dynamics, and AI compute shifts to mitigate single-point-of-failure supply risks and unlock transformational capacity opportunities. Mentor and lead cross-functional working groups across APAC to align regional execution with AI2 long-term technology roadmaps. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

new_jobs.title: Coupang Taiwan Launch Director
new_jobs.jd: **Company Introduction** Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door. Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Oversea” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond. We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” **Role Overview** The Director of TW Logistics Launch is an executive leadership role responsible for steering the end-to-end physical infrastructure and launch lifecycle across Taiwan. This position leads multi-site fulfillment network expansion—spanning land banking, real estate investment structuring, build-to-suit construction, advanced layout/CAD design, MEP engineering compliance, material handling equipment (MHE) automation, and operational launch readiness. Working at the strategic level, the Director orchestrates annual infrastructure planning, manages multi-million dollar CAPEX/OPEX budgets, oversees complex regulatory permitting, and leads specialized engineering/launch teams (Equipment, Construction, Automation Control, Real Estate, and Capacity Planning) to execute flawless greenfield and brownfield launches in a high-growth E-commerce ecosystem. **What You Will Do** **Strategic Infrastructure Program & Capacity Management** * Annual Infrastructure Plan & Master Strategy: Formulate and execute Taiwan’s long-term infrastructure master plan, aligning network expansion, hub/sub-hub/camp footprints, and capital allocation with corporate business projections. * Portfolio-Level Program Management: Oversee end-to-end program delivery (PMO) for multiple concurrent greenfield and brownfield site launches, managing critical path milestones, risk escalation protocols, and execution dashboards. * Network & Labor Capacity Optimization: Oversee node-level volume forecasting, capacity allocation, and manpower planning frameworks to maximize fixed overhead absorption and prevent throughput bottlenecks across Last-mile and Middle-mile operations. **Real Estate Development, Build-to-Suit & Permitting** * **Real Estate Strategy & Land Acquisition:** Lead macro-level site selection, land banking, build-to-suit (BTS) developments, forward-funding models, and complex commercial real estate lease/purchase negotiations. * **Investment Governance & Capital Allocation:** Build and defend high-stakes business cases, financial models, and underwriting proposals for C-level and institutional partners. * **Permitting & Government Relations:** Drive institutional stakeholder management to navigate local government entitlements, zoning compliances, environmental impact assessments, building permits, and fire safety certifications. **Construction Management, Engineering & Site Oversight** * Construction Execution & Contractor Oversight: Lead the complete construction delivery lifecycle—from contractor tendering and daily site supervision to quality defect resolution, structural inspections, and operational handover. * Multi-Disciplinary Engineering Governance: Direct technical execution across Civil Engineering, MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing), High-Voltage Electricity, Fire Fighting Systems, and IT Network Infrastructure. * Layout Design & CAD Management: Direct warehouse layout engineering, internal flow optimization, CAD drawings review, and spatial interface checks for greenfield and brownfield facilities. **Logistics Equipment & Automation Design** * **Strategic Procurement & Incoterms Management:** Oversee global and local procurement strategies for operation-critical MHE (conveyors, sorters, racks). Direct cross-border workflows, vendor selection, and Incoterms 2020 execution. * **Advanced Automation System Ownership:** Lead technical teams in reviewing Auto-Sorter designs, PLC controls (Siemens, Mitsubishi, Omron), SCADA platforms, EPLAN schematics, and WMS/WCS system interfaces. * **Site Installation & Testing:** Direct Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Integration Testing (SIT), and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) to ensure high-voltage safety and automated operational readiness. **Budgeting, EHS & Change Leadership** * CAPEX / OPEX Financial Ownership: Own total financial responsibility for infrastructure expenditures; structure, track, and optimize multi-million dollar CAPEX and launch OPEX budgets. * Safety & Regulatory Compliance (EHS): Enforce strict local/international building regulations and internal EHS standards across all construction sites and automated facilities. * Innovative Mindset & Change Management: Drive continuous process innovation (PI), smart factory data collection, and standardized trouble-shooting guides to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous e-commerce environment. **Basic Qualifications** * Experience: 12–15+ years of progressive leadership experience in logistics real estate development, facility construction management, engineering launch programs, or industrial expansion within high-growth E-commerce, 3PL, or Retail Supply Chain sectors. * Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Electrical/Control Engineering, Real Estate, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Advanced certifications (e.g., PMP, Professional Engineer/PE, Architect license) are highly desirable. * Technical & Domain Expertise: Industrial / logistics industry domain knowledge and familiar with market. Demonstrated track record of executing greenfield and brownfield warehouse launches, incorporating AutoCAD designs, structural engineering, MEP systems, and local Taiwan building codes/permitting. (Small-scale sites with a Gross Floor Area (GFA) under 5,000 pyeong (approx. 16,500 m²) Hands-on familiarity with automated sorting systems, MHE procurement, vendor contract management, and PLC/SCADA control frameworks. Deep knowledge of end-to-end real estate expansion: site underwriting, land banking, BTS developer management, and municipal entitlements. * **Financial & Data Acumen** : Strong expertise in multi-million dollar CAPEX/OPEX budget management, ROI modeling, and value engineering. Proficiency in data-driven management, KPI tracking, and executive dashboard tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). * **Leadership & Competencies** : Proven ability to manage multidisciplinary teams (civil/automation engineers, real estate managers, PMO leads) and external stakeholders (contractors, government officials, vendors). High adaptability to dynamic environments (Familiar with Changes) with an Innovative Mindset focused on scalable supply chain infrastructure. * **Languages** : Professional fluency in both spoken and written **English and Mandarin (Chinese)** is strictly required for cross-border collaboration and local regulatory alignment

new_jobs.title: AI-native Backend Engineer
new_jobs.jd: We're looking for a full-time Backend Engineer to build and operate the systems behind our product. You'll work closely with our frontend team on the APIs they build against, and with our AI team on the agents behind them. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll ship to users in weeks rather than quarters. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and operate the backend services powering our product * Partner with our AI team to harden the agents they build * Own architectural decisions in your domain, making explicit trade-offs between performance, cost, and delivery speed * Keep production healthy: observability, incident response, and turning postmortems into system improvements * Work directly with the product team to shape what gets built, not just how it gets built **Must-Have Qualifications** * 6+ years of backend development experience, shipping and maintaining production services * Strong proficiency in Python, writing idiomatic, production-grade code * Proven experience designing customer-facing APIs (REST, WebSocket, SSE) and integrating services in a microservices architecture * Hands-on experience deploying and debugging services with Docker and Kubernetes * Deep relational database knowledge: schema design, indexing, and query optimization * Strong testing discipline across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels * AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode) already part of your daily workflow, with a rigorous approach to verifying what they produce **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with an agent framework (LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, or similar) * Experience as the primary owner of a production backend system * Experience as an early engineer at a startup, building systems from zero to production * Experience owning product or platform architecture, including large-scale refactoring or service decomposition * Production experience with embeddings and vector search (pgvector, RAG optimization) * Strong DevOps skills: CI/CD, release strategies, and infrastructure-as-code on AWS or GCP * Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) * Experience with Golang or Rust, or message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ) **Compensation** Compensation for this role emphasizes long-term upside and meaningful ownership. We offer a combination of salary and equity—structured to reflect your experience, ownership mindset, and the impact you'll have on the company. This is a role for someone who wants to build, not just operate. You’ll be rewarded as a true contributor to the company’s growth, with equity that aligns your success directly with Deeli AI’s long-term value creation. **DON'T APPLY FOR THIS ROLE if your primary goal is to make a substantial immediate jump in cash salary.** **Why Join Us?** * Define how enterprise product decisions are made—grounded in real customer data and usage insight, not guesswork * High ownership: As our senior backend engineer, your decisions will shape how global enterprises discover, evaluate, and act on emerging technologies * Meaningful upside: Join early with meaningful ownership and long-term upside * Collaborate with top-tier talent across the Bay Area, Taiwan, and Europe **About Deeli AI** In an era of data explosion and AI breakthroughs, innovation decisions are still made based on fragmented signals and gut instinct. Every year, global R&D focused enterprises spend billions exploring new technologies—yet they often miss key opportunities or bet on the wrong ones. This isn’t just an efficiency problem. It’s a massive waste of innovation potential. At Deeli AI, we are building an AI-native innovation intelligence platform that helps innovation-driven organizations make confident, data-backed technology decisions. Our mission is to empower every innovation-driven organization to make confident, data-backed decisions—at the right time, with the right signals. We aggregate global deep tech signals—academic research, patents, grants, and stealth startups—to surface emerging technologies before the market reacts. Founded by a second-time entrepreneur and built by a world-class team with experience at MediaTek, AWS, and Deloitte, we're backed by the Berkeley SkyDeck Fund in Silicon Valley, ITIC (a deep tech fund in Taiwan), and NVIDIA Inception. We're already collaborating with multiple top semiconductor companies worldwide, with pilots valued in the hundreds of thousands of dollars. This is the perfect time to join us—at an inflection point where your contribution will directly shape both our product and the future of innovation intelligence.
